meta.name: docs-as-code-baseline
meta.description: Enforce minimum docs set (README, ARCHITECTURE, DECISIONS, CONTRIBUTING) and update behavior when code changes. Use as a continuous documentation guardrail.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动维护项目必备文档集，随代码变更同步更新
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望项目文档随代码自动更新且保持规范
copy.tagline_en: Enforce and auto-update essential project docs as code changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want docs to stay in sync with code changes automatically

howto.what: Claude 会强制检查项目是否包含 README、ARCHITECTURE、DECISIONS、CONTRIBUTING 这四份文档，并在代码变更时自动更新它们。
howto.when: 当你要求修改架构、重构、发布、配置或依赖时，Claude 会触发文档检查与更新流程。

say.text: 帮我更新架构文档，我改了数据库连接方式。
检查项目文档是否齐全，并补充缺失的部分。
say.note: Claude 会验证四份必备文档是否存在，缺失则创建。

howto.what_en: Claude enforces a minimum docs set (README, ARCHITECTURE, DECISIONS, CONTRIBUTING) and updates them when code changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request architecture changes, refactoring, releases, config, or dependency changes.

say_en.text: Update the architecture doc; I changed the database connection.
say_en.note: Claude reads current code and syncs the ARCHITECTURE file.

say_en.text: Check if project docs are complete and fill in missing ones.
say_en.note: Claude verifies the four required docs and creates any missing.
